text.formatted: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.
text.plain: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

text.formatted: The tough makes two attacks, using Warhammer or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.
text.plain: The tough makes two attacks, using Warhammer or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +5, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the tough pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the tough pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.
